sloka: अथ मामब्रवीत् सीता गृह्यतामयमुत्तमः ।मणिर्येन महाबाहू रामस्त्वां बहुमन्यते ।। ५.५८.१०१ ।।।।
transliteration: atha māmabravīt sītā gṛhyatāmayamuttamaḥ ।maṇiryena mahābāhū rāmastvāṁ bahumanyate ।। 5.58.101 ।।।।

translations.english: "Sita then said to me, 'Take this best of gems and present it to the longarmed Rama as a token'.
